title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: North Fork Theatre, Jericho | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the North Fork Theatre in Westbury, situated in Jericho, New York, USA, on 14 July 2006.

It was the 20th show by the ninth All-Starr Band, and the second of two nights in Jericho. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Starr had previously performed at the theatre, then known as the Westbury Music Fair, on 21 and 24 February 1999, 16 and 17 May 2000, and 4 and 5 August 2003. He returned there on 29 June 2008, 30 June 2010, and 11 June 2014.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
